title: A Survey on Gender Bias in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: As a survey paper, it evaluates and categorizes numerous methodologies used across the NLP field to measure gender bias. These include Point-wise Mutual Information (PMI) for gender descriptions, stereotype scoring, performance metric disparities (e.g., accuracy, F1, BLEU) across genders, projection-based measures and cosine similarity (like WEAT and SEAT) for word/sentence embeddings, Translation Gender Bias Index (TGBI) for machine translation, and causal testing via pseudo-log-likelihood masked language model scoring.
